title.zh: Hyperliquid Labs 解质押并场外出售 375 万枚 HYPE
title.en: Hyperliquid Labs Unstakes and Sells 3.75M HYPE via OTC

current_state.zh: HyperLabs OTC出售375万枚HYPE的买家身份仍未知，PURR已否认参与；此前链上数据显示资金归集至疑为OTC买家的地址0x875...1d1。
current_state.en: The buyer of HyperLabs' 3.75M HYPE OTC sale remains unknown; PURR has denied involvement; on-chain data previously showed funds consolidated to a suspected OTC buyer address 0x875...1d1.

updates.title_zh: ⚡️Hyperliquid Labs今日将解质押375万枚代币，并通过场外交易出售给机构
updates.title_en: ⚡️Hyperliquid Labs今日将解质押375万枚代币，并通过场外交易出售给机构
updates.what_changed_zh: Hyperliquid Labs将于今日解锁375万枚HYPE代币，并于10月7日分发给团队成员，这是一笔绕过公开市场的机构场外交易。
updates.what_changed_en: Hyperliquid Labs will unstake 3.75 million HYPE tokens today and distribute them to team members on October 7 as part of an institutional OTC deal that bypasses the public market.
updates.current_state_zh: Hyperliquid Labs将于今日解锁375万枚HYPE代币，并于10月7日分发给团队成员，这是一笔绕过公开市场的机构场外交易。

updates.title_zh: 🔍  链上侦探 |  HyperLabs已将187.5万枚HYPE转至5个OTC买家钱包
updates.title_en: 🔍  链上侦探 |  HyperLabs已将187.5万枚HYPE转至5个OTC买家钱包
updates.what_changed_zh: HyperLabs已完成375万枚HYPE的解质押，价值约3.3亿美元，并已将187.5万枚HYPE（50%）分发给五个OTC买家钱包，每个37.5万枚，这些代币流向一位未披露的机构买家，而非公开市场。
updates.what_changed_en: HyperLabs completed unstaking 3.75M HYPE worth roughly $330M and has distributed 1.875M HYPE (50%) to five OTC buyer wallets at 375,000 each, with the tokens going to an undisclosed institutional buyer rather than the open market.

updates.title_zh: Hyperliquid开发团队或通过OTC出售375万枚HYPE，其中125万枚已被重新质押
updates.title_en: Hyperliquid开发团队或通过OTC出售375万枚HYPE，其中125万枚已被重新质押
updates.what_changed_zh: 链上监测显示HyperLabs赎回并分发的375万枚HYPE最终归集至疑为OTC买家的机构地址，其中125万枚被重新质押，250万枚仍留在钱包中。
updates.what_changed_en: On-chain monitoring shows HyperLabs' redeemed and distributed 3.75M HYPE ultimately consolidated to a suspected OTC buyer institutional address, with 1.25M HYPE re-staked and 2.5M HYPE still held in wallets.
updates.current_state_zh: HyperLabs已赎回并分发375万枚HYPE（约3.32亿美元），资金最终归集至疑为OTC买家的机构地址0x875...1d1；其中125万枚（约1.1亿美元）被重新质押，250万枚（约2.2亿美元）仍留在钱包中。
updates.current_state_en: HyperLabs has redeemed and distributed 3.75M HYPE (about $332M), with funds ultimately consolidated to a suspected OTC buyer institutional address 0x875...1d1; 1.25M HYPE (about $110M) was re-staked, and 2.5M HYPE (about $220M) remains in wallets.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 链上监测显示 Hyperliquid 开发团队 HyperLabs 赎回并分发的 375 万枚 HYPE（约 3.32 亿美元）最终归集至疑为 OTC 买家的机构地址，其中 125 万枚（约 1.1 亿美元）被重新质押，250 万枚（约 2.2 亿美元）仍留在钱包中。
updates.detailed_summary_en: 链上监测显示 Hyperliquid 开发团队 HyperLabs 赎回并分发的 375 万枚 HYPE（约 3.32 亿美元）最终归集至疑为 OTC 买家的机构地址，其中 125 万枚（约 1.1 亿美元）被重新质押，250 万枚（约 2.2 亿美元）仍留在钱包中。

updates.what_changed_zh: PURR CEO David Schamis公开否认其公司是Hyperliquid Labs 375万枚HYPE OTC交易的买家。
updates.what_changed_en: PURR CEO David Schamis publicly denied that his company was the buyer of Hyperliquid Labs' 3.75M HYPE OTC sale.

updates.title_zh: HyperLabs 9 小时前解质押 375 万枚 $HYPE（3.314 亿美元），用于分配给团队
updates.title_en: HyperLabs unstaked 3.75M $HYPE ($331.4M) 9 hours ago to distribute to the team m
updates.what_changed_zh: HyperLabs 解质押 375 万枚 HYPE（约 3.314 亿美元），用于分配给团队成员，并计划通过场外交易出售这些代币；链上追踪显示，其中 125 万枚 HYPE 已重新质押，其余部分分散在两个钱包中。
updates.what_changed_en: HyperLabs unstaked 3.75 million HYPE (~$331.4M) to distribute to team members and plans to sell the tokens via OTC, with on-chain tracking showing 1.25M HYPE restaked and the remainder split across two wallets.
